name: pf
description: Reads the firewall's filter log: every packet a rule with logging on allowed or denied (data source 1), polled, or received over a remote syslog target over TCP, which then replaces polling.

endpoints.name: filter_log
endpoints.note: limit defaults to 1000; limit=0 is coerced back to 1000. An empty array does not distinguish disabled logging from no matching traffic.

push.name: filter_log
push.survey_section: Push sources: remote syslog and NetFlow export, read from source for push sources
